sn22.123:1.2: kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.123:2.1: sutavatāvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā katame dhammā yoniso manasikātabbāti.
sn22.123:2.2: sutavatāvuso koṭṭhita, bhikkhunā pañcupādānakkhandhā aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato yoniso manasikātabbā.
sn22.123:2.5: sutavatāvuso koṭṭhita, bhikkhunā ime pañcupādānakkhandhā aniccato dukkhato …pe… anattato yoniso manasikātabbā.
sn22.123:2.6: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ sutavā bhikkhu ime pañcupādānakkhandhe aniccato dukkhato …pe… anattato yoniso manasikaronto sotāpattiphalaṃ sacchikareyyāti.
sn22.123:4.1: arahatā panāvuso sāriputta, katame dhammā yoniso manasikātabbāti.
sn22.123:4.2: arahatāpi kho āvuso, koṭṭhita, ime pañcupādānakkhandhā aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato yoniso manasikātabbā.
sn22.123:4.3: natthi kho āvuso arahato uttari karaṇīyaṃ, katassa vā paticayo,
sn22.123:4.4: api ca ime dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya ceva saṃvattanti satisampajaññāya cāti.
